'''Rod Latham One In A Million Kid!''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls117.htm One In A Million Kid!], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010227192959/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls117.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million|TA-L-massassibaseoperations.gif}}
